import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULO = 1000000007;
    static boolean[] visitedArray;

    static void runDFS(boolean[] visited, long current, int factor, int modVal) {
        if (!visited[(int) current]) {
            visited[(int) current] = true;
            runDFS(visited, (current * factor) % modVal, factor, modVal);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        long total = 1;
        visitedArray = new boolean[p + 1];

        if (k == 1)
            total = p;

        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (!visitedArray[i]) {
                runDFS(visitedArray, i, k, p);
                total = (total * p) % MODULO;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
